title: Buffalo Shredded Chicken Bowl
description: Buffalo shredded chicken and cheese over roasted diced russets or oven hash browns.

ingredients.note: or oven hash browns instead (R2, Oven Hash Browns, recipes/0fba731d0d13.json)
for the potatoes, plus a little oil for the pan

ingredients.item: sour cream; ranch or blue cheese

steps: Potatoes (from Oven Air Fry Chef, not yet tested by Joe): dice the russets 3/4 inch and pat them dry. Toss with oil and seasoning.
Spread on a lightly oiled half sheet pan, max 2 lb per batch. Rack position 3.
Preheat with Bake 425F. When preheated, cancel Bake.
Air Fry 425F for 25 min, flipping and stirring at 12 min. Done when fork-tender with golden edges. Add 3 min if needed.
Hash brown option instead of the potatoes: make Oven Hash Browns (R2, recipe 0fba731d0d13) as that recipe says.
Warm about 1 cup shredded chicken in the microwave, covered, 1 to 2 min. Toss with 2 to 3 Tbsp Buffalo sauce (R8).
Put the potatoes or hash browns in a bowl. Pile on the Buffalo chicken, top with shredded mozzarella or habanero jack.
Microwave 30 to 45 sec (or Air Fry mode 425°F for 3 to 5 min) to melt the cheese.
Top with sour cream and a drizzle of ranch or blue cheese. Optional: broccoli on the side (R16).
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R23
notes: Changed Oct 24, 2026 from baked potato to a bowl, per Joe (doesn't eat baked potatoes).

not_healthy: Buffalo sauce and seasoning add sodium.
Roasting oil or hash browns add fat.
Cheese, sour cream and ranch or blue cheese add saturated fat.
